summary: Vitamin D helps calcium absorption and supports bone, muscle, nerve and immune functions.

functions.title: Physiological role
functions.description: Vitamin D helps calcium absorption and supports bone, muscle, nerve and immune functions.

functions.title: Food context
functions.description: Fatty fish and fortified foods provide vitamin D; fortification differs by product and country.

referenceValues.notes: FDA label reference for adults and children aged 4+. Not a personalised target, EAR, RDA or UL.

foodSourceRules.notes: Comparable source-backed composition per 100 g; not a health score or a measure of individual absorption.

absorptionFactors.description: Vitamin D is fat soluble and is absorbed with dietary fat; conditions affecting fat absorption can affect vitamin D status.

deficiency.overview: Vitamin D deficiency can cause rickets in children and osteomalacia in teens and adults; a food log cannot diagnose either condition.
deficiency.medicalBoundary: Symptoms are nonspecific and cannot diagnose a nutrient deficiency. Diagnosis may require clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory testing.

excess.overview: Excessive supplemental vitamin D can cause serious harm, including kidney problems and abnormal heart rhythm.
excess.medicalBoundary: An upper limit is not an intake goal. Seek medical or professional advice before changing supplement or medication use.
